environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 9.0.2-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

build: production bundle (.vite/build), check-no-mocks OK, launched as `electron .` with a temporary userData

idle.note: app open (main window, no recording yet, recorder window not created); Electron percentCPUUsage x logical cores, and the OS TotalProcessorTime delta

avSync.method: beep onsets (1 kHz band, silencedetect) vs flash onsets (beacon crop brightness) in the recorded file; offset = flash minus beep
avSync.driftNote: drift = mean(end offsets) - mean(start offsets) (the beeps are 10.0111 s apart so successive beeps fall on different phases of the 30 fps frame grid and the quantisation averages out); constant latencies cancel

process.osCpuNote: TotalProcessorTime deltas of the processes alive at both ends (start/end of the recording); a cross-check of getAppMetrics

disk.streamVsFinalNote: stream.webm (live MediaRecorder file) vs the remuxed output; the session folder is deleted after publishing
